tests.name: inbound envelope > [DI-31] a complete envelope parses and its payload matches the ERP order schema
inbound envelope > [DI-31] an envelope without a field, with a number for text or an extra field is malformed
inbound envelope > [DI-31] a payload value travels as decimal text with its unit, never as a JSON number
inbound envelope > [meta] the raw payload hash is the SHA-256 of the bytes received
acknowledgment and retry rule > [DI-31] only TRANSPORT is retried; every other class is recorded and negatively acknowledged
acknowledgment and retry rule > [meta] back-off doubles from 1 s and stops growing at 5 minutes, without a limit on attempts
acknowledgment and retry rule > [meta] failures are classified by kernel code, system code or SQLSTATE; an unknown refusal is not guessed
reconciliation checksum > [DI-31] the checksum is over distinct keys in byte order, so order and resends do not change it
system contracts > [meta] every source system has a contract whose message types carry its prefix
